observations_recorded_not_claimed_as_res: The four non-Latin items' intent argmax matched the author's gloss (billing, access, billing, access) with c between 0.9430 and 0.9986.

The three English control items under this artifact gave c of 0.9589, 0.6756 and 0.3346 - LOWER than the non-Latin items. The two item sets are NOT difficulty-matched and the glosses are not gold labels, so this is NOT a cross-channel result; it is exactly the kind of difference the English sensitivity run required by SS5.5/SS12 exists to separate from the channel effect.
verified.scope: Proves the artifact runs from the pin and reads the non-Latin scripts through the frozen wire format (Phase II SS5 criterion (iii)). Does NOT prove any Phase II result: no noise, no gold labels, no accuracy.

drift_note: The revision is the same commit the root pin uses, so no drift was possible at download time. What distinguishes the two pins is not the commit but the FILE SET: a pin that fixes the root's five files does not describe these five.
local_snapshot_note: The SNAPSHOT ROOT, matching the root pin's convention: entries in `files` are relative to it, so they carry the `multilingual/` prefix.
